zotero.abstractNote: Version 4.0 of the Gravitational-Wave Transient Catalog (GWTC-4.0) adds new candidates detected by the LIGO, Virgo, and KAGRA observatories during the first part of the fourth observing run (O4a). We report on 181 gravitational-wave candidates, including 166 binary black hole mergers, 12 binary neutron star mergers, and 3 neutron star-black hole mergers. We provide updated estimates of the merger rates and mass distributions of these populations.
